# AssessIQ

India-first B2B assessment platform for IT hiring, campus recruitment, and educational institutions — skills tests, aptitude assessments, AI-assisted evaluation of written answers, certificates, and team skill-gap analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://assessiq.in/) — Overview of the AssessIQ platform: what it does, who it's for, and why evidence-based assessment matters for Indian hiring and education.
- [IT & Tech Hiring](https://assessiq.in/solutions/it-hiring) — How AssessIQ helps IT companies screen developers and technical candidates with structured, rubric-scored skills tests.
- [Campus Recruitment](https://assessiq.in/solutions/campus-recruitment) — Bulk pre-placement assessment for fresher hiring: run structured, auditable tests for hundreds of candidates simultaneously.
- [Educational Institutions](https://assessiq.in/solutions/educational-institutions) — Online exams, skill certification, and team skill-gap analytics for colleges and universities.
- [Team Skill-Gap](https://assessiq.in/solutions/team-skill-gap) — Map your current team's competencies, identify training needs, and track progress with structured internal assessments.
- [Pricing](https://assessiq.in/pricing) — AssessIQ pricing by capability tier (Starter, Growth, Enterprise). All pricing is custom — contact for a quote.
- [Security & Trust](https://assessiq.in/security) — How AssessIQ handles data protection, India DPDP Act awareness, data location, encryption in transit, multi-tenant isolation, audit logging, and assessment integrity.
- [Trust Center](https://assessiq.in/trust) — Controls, sub-processors, data location and how AI is used for written answers, on one page.
- [Online assessment platforms in India](https://assessiq.in/resources/online-assessment-platforms-in-india) — Neutral table of platforms used in India from each vendor's public site, and five questions to ask when choosing.
- [Percentile Calculator](https://assessiq.in/tools/percentile-calculator) — Free in-browser tool: score to percentage and percentile rank in a group.
- [Accessibility](https://assessiq.in/accessibility) — Self-assessment against WCAG 2.2 A and AA for this website: what was tested, results per criterion, known gaps.
- [About](https://assessiq.in/about) — Mission, approach, and the principles behind AssessIQ's evidence-based assessment model.
- [Contact](https://assessiq.in/contact) — Get in touch for demos, pricing enquiries, campus assessment setup, or partnership questions.
